categories.main_business_segments: The company operates primarily in three core business segments: green energy solutions, residential energy storage and photovoltaic grid-connected inverters, and high-voltage frequency converters. The green energy solutions segment includes residential and commercial photovoltaic EPC projects and villa green electricity solutions. The residential energy storage and photovoltaic inverter segment focuses on R&D and production of integrated energy storage systems and inverters. The high-voltage frequency converter segment serves industrial automation with products used in power, metallurgy, coal mining, petrochemical, and construction industries.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company emphasizes proprietary R&D and vertical integration in hardware and software, including power electronics, battery management systems (BMS), energy management systems (EMS), and inverter technologies. It employs modular stackable designs, AI-driven intelligent strategies, and advanced power semiconductor technologies. Manufacturing includes advanced production lines, cleanrooms, and digitalized smart factories. The company also holds multiple international certifications and collaborates with global testing authorities to ensure product quality and safety.
categories.primary_customers_markets: Key customers include residential homeowners, commercial and industrial enterprises, and utility-scale energy projects. The company serves the renewable energy sector, particularly photovoltaic and energy storage markets, as well as industrial automation clients across power generation, metallurgy, petrochemical, and mining industries. Major customers include financial leasing companies and industrial enterprises, with a significant portion of sales concentrated in China and growing overseas markets.
categories.geographic_coverage: The company primarily operates in China, with domestic sales accounting for over 94% of revenue. It has expanded overseas markets, especially in Europe, Australia, Asia, and Africa, focusing on residential energy storage and photovoltaic products. The company has established local warehouses and sales teams abroad to support global customers. Key manufacturing and R&D bases are located in Beijing, Hefei, Suzhou, and Anqing.
categories.supply_chain_position: The company operates mainly in the midstream and downstream segments of the renewable energy and industrial automation supply chains. It develops and manufactures core components such as inverters, energy storage systems, and frequency converters, and provides EPC services and integrated energy solutions. The company maintains control over critical technologies and production processes, reducing reliance on external suppliers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: Strategic priorities include deepening focus on core businesses, accelerating product innovation, and expanding global market presence. R&D efforts target next-generation energy storage products, advanced photovoltaic inverters, AI integration, and four-quadrant energy feedback frequency converters. The company invests heavily in digital platforms for energy management and smart operation, and pursues international certifications to enhance competitiveness. It also emphasizes cost reduction, manufacturing automation, and lifecycle management services.
categories.revenue_model: Revenue is generated primarily through product sales of photovoltaic EPC projects, energy storage systems, inverters, and frequency converters. The company also earns income from long-term operation and maintenance services, project financing arrangements, and after-sales services. Sales channels include direct sales, regional agents, and distributors, with a growing emphasis on digital marketing and platform-based customer acquisition.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: The company is positioned as a leading domestic player in high-voltage frequency converters and a growing competitor in the photovoltaic and energy storage markets. It benefits from the backing and brand authorization of Midea Group, enhancing its market credibility. The industry is highly competitive with many domestic and international players, but the company leverages vertical integration, technological innovation, and strategic partnerships to maintain and expand its market share.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, the company achieved revenue of approximately RMB 4.78 billion, representing a 220% increase year-over-year, and returned to profitability with a net profit attributable to shareholders of about RMB 10.3 million. The company’s asset base grew by 46%, with total assets exceeding RMB 4.6 billion. It has shown strong growth momentum driven by expansion in green energy solutions and energy storage segments, supported by increased R&D investment and operational efficiencies.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company emphasizes integrated, intelligent green energy solutions tailored to diverse customer needs, combining proprietary technology with Midea’s brand strength and supply chain resources. Its products feature high safety standards, modular and flexible designs, AI-driven control, and comprehensive lifecycle services. The vertical integration of R&D and manufacturing enables cost control, quality assurance, and rapid response to market demands, differentiating it in a fragmented and competitive market.
